payout_quote: Pros get paid through the app via Stripe after a shift is completed.
steps: Download the Qwick app and sign up free as a hospitality Professional with your experience and certifications.
Complete onboarding (profile verification); Qwick operates in 42 states with 350,000+ verified professionals.
Browse posted shifts (server, bartender, line cook, dishwasher, event staff) and apply; businesses select applicants.
Work the shift (GPS-verified check-in); get paid through the app via Stripe after the shift is completed.
catches: Businesses select applicants — applying does not guarantee a shift.
Shift rates are set per posting and vary by role and market; Qwick publishes no fixed hourly range.
Work is concentrated in 42 states / 47+ cities — availability depends on your market.
Requires hospitality experience and meeting Qwick's professional verification standards.
Gig work is inherently variable: shifts, income, and selection are never guaranteed.
biggest_catch: You only earn when a business picks your application and you work the shift — Qwick publishes no guaranteed hours or pay rates.
eligibility: Hospitality workers 18+ who meet Qwick's professional standards in a supported US market.
timing: Shifts post continuously; pay via Stripe after each completed shift.
